WITH pair_averages AS (
  SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.anlycount) as avg_anlycount
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  LEFT JOIN trader t ON s.trdref2 = t.tradereg
  WHERE s.trdref2 IS NOT NULL AND t.tradekind IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) as overall_mean_value FROM pair_averages
),
kept_pairs AS (
  SELECT pa.transref, pa.tradekind, pa.avg_anlycount, 
         (pa.avg_anlycount - om.overall_mean_value) as above_mean
  FROM pair_averages pa CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
  WHERE pa.avg_anlycount > om.overall_mean_value
),
trader_stats AS (
  SELECT kp.tradekind, AVG(kp.avg_anlycount) as avg_analyst_count, AVG(kp.above_mean) as avg_above_mean
  FROM kept_pairs kp GROUP BY kp.tradekind
),
mean_of_means AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_above_mean) as mean_above_mean_value FROM trader_stats
)
SELECT ts.tradekind, ts.avg_analyst_count, ts.avg_above_mean,
       ts.avg_analyst_count / CAST(NULLIF(mam.mean_above_mean_value, 0) AS FLOAT) as analyst_count_ratio
FROM trader_stats ts CROSS JOIN mean_of_means mam ORDER BY ts.tradekind
